narr: Scattered afternoon thunderstorms produce isolated reports of damaging winds across portions of northeast Tennessee. An isolated flash flood also occurred.
ev: Flooding of Ralph Hoss Road, Tommy Campbell Road, and Greenwood Road, all in the same general area between the communities of Woodlawn and Lamar.
